videos.caption: We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

The golden tabby tiger, also known as the golden tiger, is an exceptionally rare color variation of the Bengal tiger. Its stunning coat is pale gold with faint orange stripes, caused by a recessive genetic mutation called chinchilla albinistic. These tigers are incredibly rare, with only about 30 known to exist, and they are found exclusively in captivity. Breeding programs in zoos and wildlife parks occasionally produce golden tabby tigers, but they are not seen in the wild due to their unique coloration, which reduces their camouflage and makes survival difficult. ⚠️ Autoridades de La Barca emitieron hace tres horas un aviso preventivo tras recibir diversos reportes ciudadanos sobre la posible presencia de un felino de gran tamaño, que de acuerdo con las descripciones podría tratarse de un tigre.  Los reportes señalan la zona de San José de las Moras, en dirección a los límites con La Providencia, por lo que se pidió a la población evitar transitar por estas brechas mientras continúan las labores de localización y verificación. Protección Civil y Bomberos informó que trabaja en coordinación con las autoridades correspondientes para determinar la ubicación del animal. 📍 En caso de observar al felino, se recomienda no acercarse, perseguirlo, intentar capturarlo o ahuyentarlo. La indicación es mantenerse a una distancia segura, buscar resguardo y reportar de inmediato a las autoridades: 📞 Emergencias: 393 935 5000 / 911. El gobierno municipal pidió evitar la difusión de información no verificada sobre el tema y mantenerse al tanto sólo de páginas oficiales. #LaBarca #proteccioncivil #Jalisco
